blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Loess is characterized by high fertility due to its rich mineral composition.
Regions with loess deposits, such as China’s Loess Plateau, support intensive agricultural activities.
The absence of vegetation makes loess deposits extremely vulnerable to severe erosion.

blocks.content: • Supports intensive agriculture (e.g., China’s Loess Plateau).

items: Exams often ask about the cause of high fertility in Loess soil—remember it is due to mineral richness.
China's Loess Plateau is a frequently tested geographical example of intensive agriculture supported by loess soil.
Be prepared for questions on soil degradation: Loess becomes highly prone to erosion specifically when vegetation is removed.

blocks.content: • Highly prone to erosion if vegetation is removed.
